description: Fork of exp696 (1.4247 @ 100.7M) with capacity expansion: embedding_dim 144 -> 192, d_v 24 -> 32. Maintains H*d_v = E (192) per exp706/707 finding that rank-preserving out_proj is preferred. Expected ~116.4M params (+15.7M vs exp696): v_lut +0.79M/layer, out_proj +1.57M/layer, tok_emb_E +1.57M. Tests whether scaling E + d_v (with H*d_v=E rule) is a working capacity lever within the emb_resid_lut design. Same tier as exp684 (140M ref). Comparison anchors: exp696=1.4247 @ 100.7M, exp684=1.4262 @ 140M, exp706=1.4371 @ 84.94M.
